title: Skill Invocation Names from Frontmatter (v2.1.94)
description: When using skills: ['./'] to reference a plugin-bundled skill, Claude Code now uses the skill's frontmatter name field as the invocation name rather than the directory basename. Previously a skill in ./my-dir/ was invoked as my-dir; now it uses whatever name: is in the SKILL.md frontmatter. Enables cleaner skill naming independent of directory structure.

evaluation.reasoning: Automatic behavior change with no config required. Relevant for plugin development — skills already have frontmatter name: fields, so this aligns runtime invocation with the declared name. Registry note only; no active workflow change needed for existing global skill setup.
